rationale: ALMS has gapped down ~53% from prior close with no news context available, creating extreme uncertainty about the catalyst and whether the move is complete. The bid-ask spread of ~181 bps is prohibitively wide for intraday trading, and the price is sitting at 30.9% of today's range with no clear directional conviction — the last five candles show a modest bounce from the low but volume is declining, making both a continuation short and a reversal long equally speculative without knowing the fundamental driver. The risk/reward is undefined without news context, and the wide spread alone would consume meaningful edge on any position.
